title: Appointments
intro: Arrange a visit with your selected brand or dealer.
notice: A visit requires explicit business confirmation. Booking is not custody receipt, work authorization or permission to release the watch.
zone: Asia/Beirut — the server checks clock changes.
pending: The result is uncertain. Check this reference or retry the same request.
review: Review current details before trying again.
empty: No appointment has been requested. Choose a purpose and a Beirut local date and time.
denied: Current access does not permit this action. Return to your account or select an authorized business.
unavailable: Current information is unavailable. Retry when the connection is restored.
stale_revision: This record or its permissions changed. Reload and review before a new request.
missing_time: This Beirut local time does not exist. Choose a different local time; nothing was shifted.
repeated_time: This Beirut local time occurs twice. Select and explicitly confirm one UTC instant.
instant_mismatch: The selected instant does not match this Beirut local time. Review the time.
elapsed: The visit must start after the current server time. Choose a future time.
slot_conflict: The business already confirmed an overlapping visit. Choose another time.
duplicate_conflict: This action reference has different details. Check its result before making a new request.
appointment_exists: A visit already exists under this reference. Reload its current details.
confirmation_conflict: This visit is no longer awaiting confirmation. Reload its current details.
not_found: No result was found. Retry the same reference if its result is uncertain.
request_limit: This request exceeds the permitted size. Review the details.
invalid_request: Enter a valid local date, HH:MM time and a duration from 15 to 120 minutes.
error: The request could not be completed. Review the details or reload current information.
repeatedAck: I confirm this exact occurrence of the repeated local time.
business: Only currently authorized business staff can explicitly confirm a visit.
